items.body:
**Minor release.** This release adds sponsor views and accessibility improvements in Municipio, enhances chat, tables, and motion in Styleguide, and improves clone imports. It also fixes authentication errors in API Alarm Integration and adds a named landmark to the Contact Banner.

[API Alarm Integration \[5.0.25...5.0.27\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration/compare/5.0.25...5.0.27)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Remote API requests now use browser `fetch` instead of WordPress’s API client, preventing WordPress nonces from being sent to the remote server and causing authentication errors.

[Contact Banner \[4.0.28...4.0.30\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-contact-banner/compare/4.0.28...4.0.30)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Accessibility:** Adds a named, localized landmark to the contact banner so assistive technology users can identify it.

[Municipio \[7.67.21...7.70.3\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.67.21...7.70.3)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Navigation:** Loads custom titles only for menu items and keeps title results separate for each menu, reducing unnecessary work.
*   **Accessibility:** Adds ARIA labels to toggle triggers and positions accessibility messages more carefully to avoid disrupting existing content.
*   **Sponsor views:** Adds views for sponsor offers and requests, with Swedish translations.
*   **Performance:** Removes an unused LiteSpeed stylesheet.

[Styleguide \[3.36.14...3.41.17\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.36.14...3.41.17)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Tables:** Improves table layouts on smaller screens and adds multi-level collapsible sections.
*   **Chat:** Adds a typing indicator and informational items, with support for a persistent default info setting.
*   **Collapsible search:** Corrects IDs to keep search controls associated with the right elements.
*   **Buttons and motion:** Adds transitions when buttons toggle and updates animation patterns and motion tokens.

[Municipio Clone \[v1.6.3...v1.6.6\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.6.3...v1.6.6)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Imports:** Preserves the destination site’s upload settings and rewrites URLs only for imported attachments.
*   **Batch cloning:** Runs each target in isolation.
*   **Performance:** Speeds up SQL imports by batching remote inserts and skipping a redundant GUID pass.
*   **Reliability:** Fixes errors when updating URL paths.

[Modularity-openstreetmap \[3.1.24...3.1.26\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-openstreetmap/compare/3.1.24...3.1.26)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Updating the map tile layer URLs from carto to openstreetmap.

**Release type: Minor.** This release expands chat capabilities, fixes form and event-request rendering issues, and makes site cloning more reliable. It adds login-gated chat, better clone progress reporting, and safeguards for URLs, GUIDs, downloads, and imported site configuration.

[Event Manager Integration \[3.1.10...3.1.12\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-event-manager-integration/compare/3.1.10...3.1.12)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Event requests:** Reads failed response bodies so browser network tracking completes correctly.

[Modularity Frontend Form \[0.84.16...0.84.18\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-frontend-form/compare/0.84.16...0.84.18)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **WYSIWYG fields:** Renders editor icons correctly when components are generated with Blade.

[Municipio \[7.67.7...7.67.21\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.67.7...7.67.21)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Nonce refresh:** Completes browser requests reliably, preventing Lighthouse navigation timeouts.
*   **Job postings:** Displays ethics policies in the paper component with paragraph formatting.
*   **Accessibility forms:** Resolves forms correctly on pages that inherit accessibility settings.
*   **Chat access:** Lets administrators require login before assistants are available and hides gated chat blocks from logged-out visitors.
*   **Chat avatars:** Prevents fatal errors when a configured avatar image is no longer available.
*   **Images:** Honors the setting to hide images.

[Styleguide \[3.37.0...3.39.2\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.37.0...3.39.2)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Chat:** Adds typing events and informational messages with muted styling.
*   **Chat information:** Corrects the default persistence behavior for added information.

[Municipio Clone \[v1.5.0...v1.6.3\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.3)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Export storage:** Keeps generated export artifacts immutable.
*   **Site URLs:** Preserves separate Home and Site URL values during cloning and reports unreadable or empty stored values clearly.
*   **Clone errors:** Shows concise, user-friendly failure messages instead of stack traces.
*   **LiteSpeed downloads:** Prevents empty export artifact downloads.
*   **Rewrite rules:** Refreshes target-site rewrite rules after import.
*   **Clone progress:** Reports SQL remapping and import progress.
*   **Root imports:** Passes explicit root authorization to streamed WP-CLI imports.
*   **GUID handling:** Preserves GUIDs during URL replacement and restores them in legacy export artifacts.

**Minor release:** Adds configurable pagination for JSON-rendered content and multi-network support for shared fields. It also improves navigation title handling, author avatar accuracy, frontend performance, image accessibility warnings, and resilience when JSON field mappings are incomplete.

Modularity JSON Render [\[4.1.2...4.2.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.1.2...4.2.0)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Pagination:** Respects the module's pagination display setting.
*   **Field Mapping:** Falls back safely when configured JSON field mappings are unavailable.

Municipio Theme [\[7.66.0...7.67.7\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.66.0...7.67.7)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Common Fields:** Adds multi-network support for shared fields.
*   **Author Avatars:** Uses the correct post author when loading byline avatars.
*   **Performance:** Avoids unnecessary archive metadata queries during normal frontend requests.
*   **Navigation:** Preserves custom menu titles in asynchronous child navigation.
*   **Performance:** Reuses cached post ancestor chains to reduce repeated database queries.
*   **Image Accessibility:** Improves the presentation of missing-alt-text warnings.

This release improves accessibility, frontend performance, and editor workflows in Municipio, while adding responsive table behavior, stronger security headers, and more flexible clone mappings.

[API Alarm Integration](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration) [\[5.0.21...5.0.23\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration/compare/5.0.21...5.0.23)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Places API:** Prevents errors when the Places API URL is not configured.

[Modularity JSON Renderer](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render) [\[4.1.0...4.1.2\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.1.0...4.1.2)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Frontend rendering:** Removes the jQuery dependency.

[Municipio Theme](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio) [\[7.54.15...7.65.1\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.54.15...7.65.1)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Accessibility:** Improves form and layout accessibility, adds text for visual error notices, and flags non-descriptive links for editors.
*   **Frontend assets:** Removes jQuery from public assets and loads component and oEmbed assets only when their markup is present.
*   **Security and robots:** Generates security and robots files dynamically.
*   **One-page templates:** Supports pages converted from non-block content.
*   **Contacts V2:** Uses the layout grid for improved responsiveness.
*   **Menus:** Fixes the menu module expansion animation and adds quick navigation to drawer menus.
*   **Editor interface:** Uses Dashicons for module actions and improves 404-page copy and buttons.
*   **Fonts:** Uses `font-display: swap` for WordPress font-library fonts.
*   **Schools:** Replaces the events section with the Events block.

[Component Library](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide) [\[3.36.14...3.37.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.36.14...3.37.0)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Tables:** Improves small-screen table layouts and adds multidimensional collapse controls.

[Municipio Clone](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone) [\[v1.4.4...v1.5.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.4.4...v1.5.0)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Clone mappings:** Supports constants as environment-variable values.

[WPMU Security](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security) [\[1.10.2...1.12.1\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.10.2...1.12.1)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Referrer policy:** Uses `same-origin` to limit referrer information sent to external sites.
*   **Subresource integrity:** Restores asset version strings by removing obsolete blocked handles.
*   **Content Security Policy:** Allows Dashicons fonts served from the same site.

**Minor release:** Municipio adds easier-reading tools, dynamic security and robots files, accessibility improvements, and better component loading. Supporting updates improve table behavior, cloning configuration, API resilience, asset compatibility, and browser security policies.

API Alarm Integration [\[5.0.21...5.0.23\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration/compare/5.0.21...5.0.23)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Places API:** Prevents Site Health errors when the Places API URL is not configured.

Modularity JSON Render [\[4.1.0...4.1.2\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.1.0...4.1.2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **JSON renderer:** Removes the jQuery dependency from frontend assets.

Municipio [\[7.54.15...7.64.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.54.15...7.64.0)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Post Module:** Adds event support for post modules.
*   **Easy Reading:** Adds a reading-assistance feature with controls for replacing page text.
*   **Menu Module:** Corrects the expand animation and adds a quick-jump option when no primary menu is available.
*   **Contacts Module:** Updates the Contacts v2 layout to use the layout grid.
*   **One-Page Templates:** Ensures converted pages continue to display their content.
*   **Frontend Assets:** Removes jQuery from public assets and loads component assets based on markup.
*   **Fonts:** Uses `font-display: swap` for WordPress font-library fonts.
*   **Security and Robots:** Generates security and robots files dynamically.
*   **Accessibility:** Adds accessibility form and layout support, and improves alternative-text error feedback.
*   **Site Health:** Adds a tidy requirement check.
*   **Embeds:** Loads component assets for oEmbed content.

Styleguide [\[3.36.14...3.37.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.36.14...3.37.0)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Tables:** Improves table layouts on small screens.
*   **Tables:** Adds multidimensional collapse behavior using container-based breakpoints.

Municipio Clone [\[v1.4.4...v1.5.0\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.4.4...v1.5.0)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Clone Mapping:** Allows environment-variable values to be supplied through PHP constants.

WPMU Security [\[1.10.2...1.12.1\]](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.10.2...1.12.1)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Referrer Policy:** Uses a same-origin referrer policy.
*   **Subresource Integrity:** Allows versioned asset URLs without maintaining blocked handle exceptions.
*   **Content Security Policy:** Allows same-origin Dashicons font files.

This release improves frontend performance through on-demand assets, adds SVG icons, modernizes JSON rendering, and strengthens editor, form, security, and data-handling behavior.

## API Alarm Integration [5.0.17...5.0.21](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/api-alarm-integration/compare/5.0.17...5.0.21)
- **Frontend:** Replaced jQuery with WordPress API utilities for alarm and disturbance data.

## Modularity EntryScape [5.0.22...5.0.24](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-entryscape/compare/5.0.22...5.0.24)
- **Rendering:** Uses the shared component template service.

## Modularity Form Builder [4.0.16...4.0.18](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-form-builder/compare/4.0.16...4.0.18)
- **Rendering:** Uses the shared component template service.

## Modularity Frontend Form [0.84.6...0.84.16](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-frontend-form/compare/0.84.6...0.84.16)
- **Editing:** Preserves static front-page URLs for frontend editing links.
- **Submissions:** Includes configured post content when loading submissions.
- **Maps:** Applies Customizer map styles and default settings consistently.
- **Styling:** Loads form styles in the correct layer priority.

## Modularity JSON Render [4.0.18...4.1.0](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-json-render/compare/4.0.18...4.1.0)
- **Architecture:** Replaced the React-based renderer with an API-based implementation.
- **Layouts:** Added list, table, and heading-free accordion display options.
- **Rendering:** Corrected asset loading and asynchronous content placement.

## Modularity Products [4.0.6...4.0.8](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-products/compare/4.0.6...4.0.8)
- **Rendering:** Uses the shared component template service.

## Modularity Recommend [4.2.4...4.2.6](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-recommend/compare/4.2.4...4.2.6)
- **Rendering:** Uses the shared component template service.

## Modularity Timeline [5.0.6...5.0.8](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-timeline/compare/5.0.6...5.0.8)
- **Rendering:** Uses the shared component template service.

## Multi Network URLs [2.0.0...2.0.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/multi-network-urls/compare/2.0.0...2.0.1)
- **Multisite:** Prevents `/wp` from being incorrectly added to new subfolder-site URLs.

## Municipio Theme [7.45.3...7.54.15](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.45.3...7.54.15)
- **Performance:** Loads component assets and only the required repeated styles on demand.
- **Icons:** Uses the SVG icon library and reduces unused icon assets.
- **Editor:** Loads all styles in Gutenberg and ensures raw-editor tables receive table styling.
- **Accessibility:** Improves menu-module accessibility and hides the "jump to main menu" link when its target is absent.
- **Forms and Maps:** Improves map robustness and protects map styling when blocks are unavailable.
- **Security:** Includes user state in nonce handling and removes deprecated widgets.
- **Content:** Correctly handles ampersands and aligns job-posting views with the updated data format.
- **Chat:** Lazy-loads chat and fixes initial scroll-to-latest-message behavior.

## Styleguide [3.33.5...3.36.14](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.33.5...3.36.14)
- **Performance:** Builds and loads component assets, utility CSS, and JavaScript only when needed.
- **Icons:** Adds SVG icon support.
- **Chat:** Adds access to the chat scroll container.
- **Styling:** Adds a plugin CSS layer and corrects collapsible-search button corners.
- **Builds:** Supports builds without a WordPress context.

## Municipio Clone [v1.4.2...v1.4.4](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.4.2...v1.4.4)
- **Reliability:** Prevents failures when import data contains `false` where serialized data is expected.
- **CLI:** Improves feedback from clone operations.

## S3 Local Index [1.2.0...1.2.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/s3-local-index/compare/1.2.0...1.2.1)
- **Reliability:** Prevents concurrent index operations from losing data.

## WPMU Security [1.10.1...1.10.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.10.1...1.10.2)
- **Security:** Adds default `Referrer-Policy` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` response headers.

Minor release: introduces multipart image webhooks in Frontend Form and improves Municipio search indexing with schema-aware Typesense data. It also fixes chat button layout, popover height, menu heading text, and collapsible search button styling for a more polished user experience.

## Modularity Frontend Form [0.84.0...0.84.4](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-frontend-form/compare/0.84.0...0.84.4)
- Multipart Webhooks: Adds optional multipart webhook delivery for forms with images, making image uploads easier for connected services to receive and process.
- Image Handling: Sends native multipart image fields, skips missing optional images, and improves error reporting when webhook delivery fails.

## Municipio Theme [7.44.24...7.45.3](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.44.24...7.45.3)
- Search Index: Adds schema-type-aware schema data to the Typesense provider so more structured content can be included in search results.
- Chat Interface: Fixes chat bubble button rows so actions are displayed more consistently.
- Menu Module: Corrects missing wording in the menu module heading shown in the interface.
- Popover Cover Mode: Fixes message height issues so popover content is displayed more cleanly.

## Styleguide [3.33.5...3.33.7](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.33.5...3.33.7)
- Collapsible Search: Removes unintended corner styling on buttons in collapsible search so they match the expected appearance.

Minor release focused on layout and navigation improvements in Municipio, safer webhook startup behavior, and more reliable cloned media imports. It introduces the new Negative Space module, improves hash-link behavior across the interface, and fixes several chat, menu, editor, and packaging issues.

## Municipio Deployment
- Fixed issue that the `object-cache.php` dropin was not up to date with the installed redis-cache plugin. We now copy the dropin from the installed plugin on `post-install-cmd`. 

## Municipio Theme [7.43.13...7.44.24](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.43.13...7.44.24)
- Negative Space Module: Adds a new Modularity module for creating negative-spacing layouts without custom code.
- Chat Block: Fixes the chat block cover state, CSS classes, interaction flow, and popover spacing so the block displays and behaves correctly.
- Menu Handling: Fixes clipping and background issues in menu modules, prevents submenu arrows from wrapping onto a new line, and makes `#` links toggle child menus more reliably.
- Gutenberg Compatibility: Ensures module assets and spacing styles load correctly in the block editor and updates block-style enqueueing for WordPress 7.2.
- Table of Contents: Removes unintended background styling from TOC elements for a cleaner appearance.
- Theme Packaging: Includes `theme.json` in distributed builds so packaged releases keep the expected theme configuration.

## Styleguide [3.32.5...3.33.5](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.32.5...3.33.5)
- Hash-link Navigation: Menu items that use `#` can now open and close their child menus directly from the main link, making navigation behave more predictably on click and touch.
- Pagination Controls: Previous and next buttons now use proper disabled states, preventing pagination controls from appearing clickable when no more pages are available.

## Municipio Clone [1.4.1...v1.4.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2)
- Media Import: Rewrites remote media URLs to the source site's actual media domain so cloned images and files keep working links.

## Webhooks Manager [1.3.2...1.3.3](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/webhooks-manager/compare/1.3.2...1.3.3)
- ACF Initialization: Defers loading ACF-backed webhook settings until ACF is ready, preventing fatal errors during early WordPress startup.

Minor release: This update focuses on navigation and interface improvements. Municipio adds a redesigned menu module with more flexible layouts, improved mobile chat behavior, and new button styling controls in the header and tab menus. Styleguide delivers a major popover refresh, a new site selector component, and more consistent color inheritance for navigation and buttons.

## Municipio Theme [7.38.6...7.43.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.38.6...7.43.1)
- Chat: Moves the chat script integration and adds a full-screen chat bubble layout for mobile devices.
- Language Menu: Fixes placement issues so the language switcher opens in the correct position.
- Menu Module: Introduces a clearer visual design with working expand and collapse behavior.
- Menu Module: Makes menu columns more fluid and adds a spaced layout option for better content balance.
- Header Buttons: Adds settings for controlling button styles in the header.
- Tab Menu: Adds support for button appearance settings in the tab menu alternative.
- Mega Menu: Keeps the mega menu label visible on mobile devices to avoid navigation issues.


## Styleguide [3.24.18...3.31.4](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.24.18...3.31.4)
- Popover: Reworks the popover component with a cleaner implementation, a new cover mode, and a smaller API.
- Popover: Improves positioning behavior by resetting calculations before placement and handling dropdown overflow more reliably.
- Site Selector: Adds a redesigned site selector component with updated sizing, spacing, and examples.
- Navigation Colors: Removes manual color overrides on basic navigation so it follows the surrounding design more consistently.
- Buttons: Lets buttons inherit the active color scheme, keeps button sizes aligned more consistently, and preserves corner shapes in SVG buttons.

## Deployment Configuration [7.38.6...7.43.1](https://github.com/municipio-se/municipio-deployment/compare/7.38.6...7.43.1)

- ACF Pro: Installs Advanced Custom Fields Pro as a must-use plugin so it loads before regular plugins.
- ACF Safety: Adds a must-use safeguard that throws a clear error if ACF fields are accessed too early.
- Municipio Clone: Adds the Municipio Clone plugin to the deployment.
- WordPress Core: Updates the Roots-managed no-content WordPress package from 7.1.1 to 7.1.2.
- WordPress Plugins: Updates Redirection to 5.10.1 and Redis Cache to 3.0.0.

This release updates the WordPress and WordPress plugin providers to Roots.io.

It also includes a minor fix to ensure that the correct configuration keys are used when enabling features in Like Posts, Event Manager Integration, and the Municipio theme's chat feature.
